notes: Raw inputs, components and service fees for composed items. checked is the date the price was seen on its source: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, or YYYY (year only). Empty means the source shows no date. A price is fresh only with month precision and a date within 12 months before 2026-10-27. moq is the minimum order in the material's unit. moq_per_item means each design pays its own minimum (PCBs and assembly fees); otherwise the minimum is shared across the pass. per_order marks a fee paid once per order, so it does not grow with the number of drones. Placeholders are guesses. Unpriced inputs count as $0.

pla_per_kg.note: Makers' US stores on 2026-10-27: Sunlu PLA $10.29 a 1 kg roll; Elegoo $109.99 for 10 kg ($11.00 per kg) and $13.49 for 1 kg; Polymaker Panchroma Basic $17.99 for 1 kg. Replaces year-only 2026 B2B guide figures.

pla_pellets_per_kg.note: Raw PLA resin pellets, asking prices at a 25 kg minimum: $1.00 to $4.85 per kg. Undated. Needs an extruder to become filament, which breaks even only after roughly 45 to 285 kg at the filament prices of 2026-10-27, so no pass uses it.

fr4_single_sided_per_cm2.note: Single-sided copper-clad FR4. Newark $1.43 for 160 cm2 to Mouser $10.73 for about 97 cm2, undated. Both pages timed out on 2026-10-27, so this was not re-checked.

etchant_ferric_per_l.note: On 2026-10-27: Takach $46 a gallon ($12.15 per liter) and $140 for four gallons ($9.25 per liter); Circuit Specialists $18.01 for 1 liter and $47.47 for a 4 liter jug. Reusable.

magnet_wire_per_kg.note: Low: a March 2026 listing at $11.85 to $13.85 (unit and minimum unclear). High: a 0.3 mm 140 g spool at about $44.57 per kg (undated). Factory asks of $7 to $10 per kg need 300 kg minimums. Salvaged wire is the cheapest route.

ndfeb_n52_10x2_each.note: Distributor: JC-Magnetics on 2026-10-27, $0.78 at the 25-piece minimum down to $0.26 at 5,000.

ndfeb_n52_10x2_factory_each.note: Nanjing Huajin on 2026-10-27, one listing for 10 x 2 and 15 x 2 mm N52 discs: $0.10 each at 10 to 1,999 pieces, $0.05 at 2,000 to 4,999, $0.01 at 5,000 or more. The $0.01 tier is left out: a 1.2 g magnet holds about $0.05 of rare earth at September 2026 metal prices. The Alibaba page listed before is gone. Specify grade, coating and magnetization direction, and pull-test a sample.

ndfeb_n52_by_weight_kg.note: Vendor range for N52 by weight, undated; the vendor page could not be read on 2026-10-27. Neodymium metal was $140.88 per kg on SMM's China benchmark on 2026-09-30 (rare-earth-mining.com).

bearing_mini_684_each.note: Miniature 4 x 9 x 4 mm bearing (684ZZ, also sold as MR94ZZ), the size class used in small drone motors. On 2026-10-27: VXB $29.99 for ten (about $3 each), Bearings Direct $4.38 each. Replaces the 608 skate bearing used earlier, which is too large for a 2207 motor.

bearing_mini_684_factory_each.note: 684ZZ factory listing on 2026-10-27: $0.16 to $0.50 at a 100-piece minimum. The AliExpress 10-pack ($8.76, about $0.88 each, undated) sits behind a sign-in and was not re-read. Quality varies: spin-test and check play before use.

steel_shaft_each.note: Not searched. Guess only. A hardened 4 mm shaft, bought or salvaged.

electrical_steel_per_kg.note: Q2 2026 benchmarks: China $1.44, US $1.99, Germany $2.09 per kg (market research, not a store price). Small lots carry a premium.

laser_cut_stator_each.note: Laser cutting of one stator lamination set. Needs a fiber laser or a cutting service: most makerspace CO2 lasers cannot cut steel. Not priced; guess only.

lamination_etch_set_each.note: Lab route: photo-etch thin electrical steel laminations with ferric chloride, the same setup as PCB etching. Etching vendors say it suits prototypes and thin laminations with no tooling. No independent data for ferric chloride on silicon steel was found, so test a coupon first. Covers photoresist and etchant share. Guess only.

stator_core_factory_each.note: Generic BLDC stator cores from a factory listing at a 1,000-piece minimum, undated; the listing blocked automated reading on 2026-10-27. Not 2207-specific: send a drawing with diameter, stack height, slot count and steel grade. New tooling takes 10 to 12 weeks (Sinotech, still stated on 2026-10-27). Small batches cost $15 to $21 each at 10 pieces.

cell_18650_each.note: Unprotected 18650 cells from a US distributor on 2026-10-27: Samsung 25R $4.99, Samsung 35E and Panasonic GA $6.99, in stock (EVE 25P $3.99, out of stock). China wholesale ($1 to $2) and US bulk ($3.09 to $3.19), undated, could not be read. Factory-direct cells ship as dangerous goods (cargo aircraft only at 30 percent charge or less, or sea freight), so small orders come from a US distributor.

tp4056_module_each.note: Single-cell charger with DW01A protection. August 2026 eBay listings at $6.11 to $7.19; Envistia $2.39 (undated).

at32f421_each.note: LCSC on 2026-10-27, two packages: $0.43 to $0.50 at about 1,000 pieces, $0.89 to $0.91 for one, both in stock. AM32 lists the AT32F421 as supported.

stm32h743_each.note: LCSC on 2026-10-27: $10.78 for one, $7.86 at 100, 120 in stock. Findchips was not re-read; the old $5.90 to $9.38 was undated.

icm42688p_each.note: Reel price (DigiKey, undated) to $6.50 for one (reseller guide dated 2026-08-23). Lead times of 45 to 53 weeks at DigiKey and Mouser.

esp32c3_mini1_each.note: ESP32-C3-MINI-1-N4 module, LCSC page fetched 2026-10-10: $3.06 for one, $2.01 at 1,300. No price date on the page.

esp32c3fh4_each.note: Bare ESP32-C3 SoC with 4 MB flash in the package. LCSC $2.18 to $1.38 (reference only, out of stock); Mouser and DigiKey $2.50 for one to $1.30 per reel. Undated. Needs a 40 MHz crystal, RF matching and an antenna, so it saves about $0.70 per unit at volume and adds RF design risk.

ch592_each.note: WCH CH592 RISC-V SoC with BLE 5.4. LCSC on 2026-10-27: CH592F $0.86 for one and $0.45 at 1,000 (1,720 in stock); CH592D $0.84 to $0.46; CH592X $0.71 to $0.52. Needs a crystal, RF matching and an antenna. BLE range must be tested in the field.

sx1262_module_each.note: LoRa module, not a bare chip. Undated.

sx1280_module_each.note: 2.4 GHz chip or module for an ELRS-style transmitter. On 2026-10-27: the bare SX1280 at LCSC $4.64 for one to $2.91 at 1,000 (4,000 in stock); Ebyte's E28-2G4M12SX module (SX1281, 12.5 dBm) on Tindie $4.97. Modules with a power amplifier were $9.80 to $13.98 before (undated); LCSC's listings for them are gone, and AliExpress and Alibaba could not be read.

gnss_atgm336h_each.note: Clone-family GNSS module. LCSC on 2026-10-27: $3.27 for one, $1.83 at 1,000, 6,888 in stock. Chipmall was not re-read. Untested here.

gnss_m9n_each.note: u-blox NEO-M9N-00B bare module. LCSC on 2026-10-27: $16.55 for one, $16.15 at ten. Symmetry now redirects to Braemac, which blocked automated reading ($10.99 at ten before, undated).

gnss_antenna_ceramic_each.note: Ceramic GNSS patch antenna. Not searched. Guess only.

mosfet_30v60a_each.note: High: a retail TO-220 part at $1.75 (Tinkersphere, last updated June 2026). Low: a guess. No LCSC listing for a 30 V PDFN5x6 ESC-class part was found. LCSC prices other power MOSFETs in cents at volume, so the low end may be generous. Search LCSC's filters directly.

fd6288q_each.note: Three-phase 250 V gate driver used in many ESCs, one per motor. On 2026-10-27 the JSMSEMI FD6288Q ($0.27 to $0.55 before) was gone from LCSC and JLCPCB. The Fortior original at LCSC: $2.37 for one to $1.15 at 1,000, out of stock. Find an in-stock equivalent before an ESC design is fixed.

passives_kit_each.note: Resistors, capacitors, crystal, connectors and current-sense parts in bulk. Estimate only.

pcb_2layer_100cm2_each.note: 10 x 10 cm, 2-layer. JLCPCB's homepage on 2026-10-27: from $2.00 for 5 boards. Shipping is extra and was not checked (one user once reported $3.50 for five with shipping, undated).

pcb_4layer_100cm2_each.note: 10 x 10 cm, 4-layer. Low: JLCPCB's page on 2026-10-27 says these start at $7, and its minimum order is five boards. High: Atlas PCB's article of 2026-07-11 gives $8 to $15 each for 5 to 10 boards from a quality manufacturer.

pcba_order_fixed.note: JLCPCB Economic PCBA: setup $8.18 plus stencil $1.53 per order, from the help page (about a month old). Standard PCBA costs more: $25.56 or $51.12 setup.

pcba_joint_each.note: JLCPCB Economic PCBA placement per solder joint.

pcba_extended_part_type_each.note: JLCPCB's assembly price page (updated 2026-10-22) and its blog (2026-10-13): $3.07 per unique Extended part per order in Economic PCBA. Basic and Preferred Extended parts load free. Standard PCBA charges $1.53 for every part type. A third-party page reported $1.50 from 2025-12-19, which JLCPCB's page does not show. The model assumes three extended types per design.

gimbal_pot_each.note: Stick potentiometer or hall sensor per axis. Not searched. Guess only.
